name: SiteNav - Default
description: The internal-page nav bar with the current page inked and underlined. The isolation page passes currentPath as '/about/' WITH a trailing slash while the nav item stores '/about' without one — the exact mismatch Astro's directory build produces, and the state that used to leave every link muted on the live site. It previously passed '/about', which matched even under the bug and so hid the regression from this capture. About is inked and teal-underlined; Contact stays muted, which is what proves the match is not lighting up every item.
